title: 2권 7유닛 장면 · 3
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Bun, Hedgie, Grumble, Beads. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: The orange cat sits on top of an open white first-aid kit on a stepping stone; Bun swings a wooden baseball bat and hits a peach pit far out over the pond with motion lines and a splash; Hedgie covers his ears; Beads threads s-i-t. In the reeds, Grumble covers both ears with his paws at the noise, his lantern glowing at his feet. Hidden in the picture: the sitting cat, the kit, the bat hitting the pit, the peach pit. Characters: Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers. Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads.
